definitions.gloss: lap blanket; lap robe; throw blanket
definitions.explanation: A small blanket or throw used to cover the legs and lap while sitting, commonly used in offices, on airplanes, or when sitting on a sofa.

examples.japanese: {膝掛|ひざか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I borrow a lap blanket?

examples.japanese: ⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{膝掛|ひざか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The office is cold, so I use a lap blanket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{膝掛|ひざか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}った→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I got a blanket on the airplane and fell asleep.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in daily life, especially for women working in air-conditioned offices. Airlines and trains often provide them. Also called ブランケット in casual contexts, especially among younger speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膝掛|ひざか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける (to put a lap blanket over one's legs)
- {膝掛|ひざか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧ (to lend a lap blanket)
- フリース⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{膝掛|ひざか}け (fleece lap blanket)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ブランケット: blanket — loanword, more casual and broader in usage
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: blanket — a full-size blanket for sleeping
